title: 지하철 노선도 읽기: 어디서 갈아타요?
objective: By the end, you can read a Korean subway map to find where to change lines, which direction to take, and how many stops a trip takes.
summary: Learners read a simple subway map to find transfer stations, directions, and the number of stops.
note: The subway map in this worksheet is made up for practice. The station names, numbers, and colors are not real.

task.title: Find your way
task.line: Use the subway map at the top of this worksheet to answer each question.

items.text: The number of a subway line. Each line has its own color on the map.
The station where you get on the train.
A station where two or more lines meet.
To get off one line and take another line.
The first or last station of a line.
Shows which way the train goes. It usually uses the name of the last station (or a major station) in that direction.
A stop (station). It is also used to count stations between two places.
A station where the express train stops. Express trains skip other stations.
items.example: 공원역은 급행 정차역이라서 급행을 타도 돼요.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: On this map, the first number of a station number shows the line: 203 is on line 2.
A transfer station has a different number on each line: 중앙 is 103 on line 1 and 202 on line 2. To choose a direction, look at the end station: from 중앙 to 공원, take the 노을 방면 train.

exercises: Look at the map and write O (true) or X (false): ① 별빛역에도 급행이 서요. ② 꽃길역에서 공원역까지는 한 정거장이에요. ③ 학교앞역의 역 번호는 203이에요.
Fill in the blanks with 갈아타요, 정거장, or 방면: ① 하늘역에서 숲속역에 가요. 중앙역에서 2호선으로 ____. ② 별빛역에서 꽃길역까지는 두 ____이에요. ③ 중앙역에서 장터역에 가려면 바다 ____ 열차를 타세요.
Put the steps in order for a trip from 별빛역 to 학교앞역: (가) 중앙역에서 내려요. (나) 별빛역에서 1호선 노을 방면 열차를 타요. (다) 학교앞역에서 내려요. (라) 2호선 바다 방면으로 갈아타요.
Answer in Korean: 하늘역에서 1호선 급행을 탔어요. 노을역에 도착하기 전에 어느 역에 서요?
Answer in Korean in one sentence: 숲속역에서 노을역까지 어떻게 가요? Say where you change lines and which direction you take.
answers: ① X ② O ③ O
① 갈아타요 ② 정거장 ③ 방면
2호선을 타고 중앙역에서 1호선 노을 방면으로 갈아타요. (숲속역에서 2호선을 타고 중앙역에서 내려서 1호선 노을 방면 열차로 갈아타요.)
